## Pasteurization Methods

Pasteurization is a heat-treatment process that destroys pathogenic microorganisms in foods and beverages.

**Note:** If the fat content of the milk product is ten percent (10%) or more, or if it contains added sweeteners, or if it is concentrated (condensed), the specified temperature shall be increased by 3ºC (5ºF).
